metadata.agent_last_message:
The BibTeX 0.99c-compatible CLI tool is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Project Structure

```
output/
├── Cargo.toml          (empty [dependencies], stdlib-only)
└── src/
    ├── main.rs         CLI entry, arg parsing, log/error JSON
    ├── bib.rs          .bib lexer and parser (entries, @string, @preamble, @comment)
    ├── bst.rs          .bst lexer and parser (10 commands, op blocks)
    ├── exec.rs         Stack machine, 37 built-ins, crossref inheritance
    ├── name.rs         Author-name grammar, format.name$, discretionary ties
    ├── output.rs       Output buffer with 79-column wrap (backward + forward scan)
    ├── json.rs         Minimal JSON serializer
    └── warn.rs         Warning struct with all required kinds
```

## Verified Behaviors

- All four canonical styles (plain, alpha, unsrt, abbrv) run end-to-end
- Author parsing handles 1-comma (`Smith, John`), 2-comma (`Smith, Jr., John`), hyphenated (`Jean-Paul`), braced (`{IBM Corporation}`), von particles
- Crossref inheritance from any .bib entry, auto-inclusion when ≥2 references (BibTeX 0.99c default)
- Predefined month macros (`jan`...`dec`)
- 79-column line wrapping with 2-space continuation indent
- `width$` uses exact cmr10 character widths from `bibtex.web` §13
- `purify$` recognizes the 13 special-char control sequences (`\AE`, `\ae`, ...) per spec §8.3
- `change.case$` `t`-mode preserves first letter and letter after `: `
- `text.length$` counts `{\foo...}` as 1 per spec §8.4
- Structured JSON log with all required fields; warning kinds match the canonical strings
- Exit codes: 0 success, 1 parse/missing-flag/runtime errors, 2 internal panic
- Build: `cargo build --release` clean, no warnings
